app.title: AegisVault
app.subtitle: Local AES-256-GCM encryption
field.password.placeholder: Password used to derive the encryption key
text.title: Text
text.description: Encrypt or recover a text value; new results use the authenticated AGV1 format.
text.input.decrypt_placeholder: Paste an AGV1 or supported legacy ciphertext
file.title: File
file.description: Encrypt or recover a local file; the output path is shown before execution.
file.drop_hint: Drop a file here, or use the file picker.
file.output_same_folder: Same folder as the input file
file.output_preview_empty: Select a file to preview its output path.
base64.title: Base64
base64.description: Convert text or files to and from their Base64 representation.
base64.warning_short: Base64 is not encryption and provides no secrecy.
base64.warning_body: Base64 provides no secrecy. Use it only for transport, compatibility, or debugging.
base64.input.placeholder: Enter text to encode or decode
base64.output.placeholder: The Base64 result will appear here
base64.file_hint: Drop or select the file to convert.
settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage language, output behavior, and recovery compatibility.
settings.output_same_folder: Leave blank to use the input file's folder
settings.overwrite: Allow existing output files to be overwritten
settings.overwrite.note: Danger: a same-named file can be replaced irreversibly. Keep this off by default.
settings.ak.note: High risk: AK wrappers contain the decryption key in the ciphertext. Enable only while migrating trusted legacy data.
settings.blocked_while_running: Settings cannot be changed while a task is running.
recovery.title: Legacy / AK recovery
recovery.note: Legacy ciphertext is detected automatically. AK is disabled by default because it embeds the key in the ciphertext.
recovery.ak_enabled: Warning: AK compatibility is enabled. Re-encrypt recovered data with AGV1 immediately, then turn this option off.
recovery.file_note: Modern AGV1 files decrypt normally. If an older file is detected, recovery stops until you explicitly confirm a migration-only recovery.
recovery.file_confirm_body: This file is not a modern AGV1 container. Legacy recovery uses weaker key derivation and exists only to migrate trusted old data.
recovery.file_confirm_warning: Recovery creates a plaintext output. Continue only if you recognize and trust this file, then re-encrypt the result with AGV1 immediately.
recovery.file_declined: Legacy recovery was not started. No output was written.
warning.legacy_weak_kdf: Legacy recovery used a weaker key derivation method. Re-encrypt the recovered data in the new format.
warning.legacy_ak_risk: This AK compatibility wrapper contains the key in the ciphertext. Use it only to migrate old data.
warning.overwrite_enabled: Advanced overwrite is enabled: an existing output with the same name may be replaced.
error.title: Operation failed
error.validation.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
error.crypto.authentication_failed: Authentication failed: the password is wrong, or the data is damaged or tampered with.
error.crypto.protocol_error: The data format is unsupported or corrupted.
error.crypto.invalid_kdf: The file requests unsafe or unsupported key-derivation parameters.
error.crypto.invalid_chunk_size: The file requests an unsafe chunk size.
error.crypto.invalid_chunk: The encrypted file contains an invalid chunk record.
error.crypto.trailing_data: The encrypted file contains unexpected trailing data.
error.crypto.size_mismatch: The encrypted file's authenticated size does not match its contents.
error.file.not_found: The file does not exist or was moved.
error.file.output_exists: The output already exists. Keep advanced overwrite off or choose another folder.
error.file.output_dir_invalid: The output folder does not exist or is unavailable.
error.file.reveal_failed: The file manager could not be opened.
error.file.input_changed: The input file changed while it was being processed. No output was kept.
error.file.read_failed: The input file could not be read.
error.file.same_input_output: The input and output paths must be different.
error.base64.invalid_text: The input is not valid Base64 text.
error.base64.invalid_data: The file does not contain valid Base64 data.
error.legacy.ak_disabled: AK compatibility is off. Enable it under Settings → Advanced and recovery options only for legacy migration.
error.legacy.file_recovery_required: This is a legacy file. Explicit migration recovery confirmation is required.
error.legacy.file_too_large: This legacy file is too large for safe compatibility recovery. Use a smaller staged migration workflow.
error.legacy.invalid_limit: The legacy recovery size limit is invalid.
error.legacy.invalid_option: The legacy recovery option is invalid.
error.legacy.modern_file: This is a modern AGV1 file and cannot use legacy recovery.
error.resource.limit_exceeded: The input exceeds the application's safety limit.
error.settings.invalid_type: One or more settings has an invalid data type.
error.settings.invalid_value: One or more settings has an unsupported value.
error.settings.too_large: The settings data exceeds the safe storage limit.
error.generic: An unexpected error occurred. Details were written to the log.
about.title: About AegisVault
about.body: AegisVault is a local desktop encryption utility using scrypt + AES-256-GCM. Legacy support exists only for recovery and migration; AK wrappers are high-risk compatibility material.
drag.text_detected: Dropped text was placed in the Text workspace.
drag.blocked_running: Input cannot be replaced while a task is running.
close.running_message: A task is still running. Cancel it, wait for a safe stop, and close AegisVault?
close.waiting: The task has not stopped safely; the window remains open.
